about.headline: Building operational software, one workflow at a time.
about.bio: I currently work as an administration staff at KJPP Ruky Safrudin dan Rekan while finishing a bachelor's degree in Informatics Engineering at Universitas Pamulang. That job is where I saw how much operational work still runs on spreadsheets, chat, and manual checks. The projects on this page came from that kind of work: order fulfillment, waste-bank ledgers, lead dispatch, and logistics auctions. I handle the build end to end, from mapping the workflow to shipping the web or mobile app.

items.title: Administration Staff · KJPP Ruky Safrudin dan Rekan
items.description: I manage and validate property valuation records and coordinate reporting data between appraisers. The work is document-heavy and deadline-driven, which is the context behind most of the systems on this page.

thinking.headline: I don't start with the stack. I start with the problem.

principles.title: UNDERSTAND
principles.description: Find what is actually getting in the way. I look at how the software behaves today, the real constraints around it, and how people actually use it before reaching for tools.

principles.title: SIMPLIFY
principles.description: Remove unnecessary complexity before adding more. I untangle architecture and strip away excess layers. Simple problems should never be solved with complicated systems.

principles.title: EVOLVE
principles.description: Improve what exists without rebuilding blindly. I optimize bottlenecks and refine the architecture step by step, keeping the system stable and ready to grow as needs change.
